cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"

grep -o "export declare function \(updateTag\|revalidateTag\|refresh\)[^;]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "updateTag" node_modules/next/cache.js node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts | head
